$comment: PR-7201 feeder protection relay twin. Expected values in Maximo Monitor from the settings sheet, IEC 60255-151 and the relay and breaker data; the relay sends only what it measures and records.

identification.model: Relion REF615 feeder protection and control (product version 5.0 FP1)
identification.description: Protection relay of 11 kV outgoing feeder F07 in a distribution substation (IEC 61850 station bus)
identification.protected_object: 11 kV cable feeder, vacuum circuit breaker Q0, CTs 400/1 A
identification.breaker: 11 kV vacuum circuit breaker with spring mechanism and shunt trip coil, 110 V DC (generic)
identification.station_bus: IEC 61850-8-1 MMS and GOOSE over PRP, PTP (IEEE 1588 v2, power profile) from the station grandmaster

feeder.source: Feeder rating and CT ratio: assumption: typical value, replace with your protection settings sheet / breaker data sheet

overcurrent.function: PHLPTOC (IEC 61850 logical node PTOC), stage 1 low
overcurrent.source: Curve formula and IEC constants: IEC 60255-151. IEEE constants as printed in relay manuals (IEEE C37.112 form). Setting ranges and accuracy (+/-5.0 % of the theoretical value or +/-20 ms in inverse time mode): ABB REF615 Product Guide 1MRS756379 U (5.0 FP1). Start value 0.90 x In and TMS 0.15 on IEC normal inverse: assumption: typical value, replace with your protection settings sheet / breaker data sheet

breaker.source: Opening time from trip command to open position, breaker failure delay (CCBRBRF 'CB failure delay', range 0...60000 ms in the ABB REF615 Product Guide 1MRS756379 U (5.0 FP1)), rated short-circuit breaking current, arcing time per break and the number of breaks at rated current the interrupters allow: assumption: typical value, replace with your protection settings sheet / breaker data sheet. Wear sum I^y x t with y = 2, as the relay's SSCBR accumulated energy does.

supervision.source: CCSPVC start value range 0.05...0.20 x In, GOOSE data exchange < 10 ms, 1 ms event time stamp resolution (offset limit 1000 us): ABB REF615 Product Guide 1MRS756379 U (5.0 FP1). 4 subscribed GOOSE data sets with a 1 s heartbeat, 1 % miss limit, and the approved settings checksum (the settings-management tool's fingerprint of the approved setting file, kept on the Maximo asset): assumption: typical value, replace with your protection settings sheet / breaker data sheet. 2190 days = 6 years, the NERC PRC-005-6 Table 1-5 maximum interval for verifying a trip coil.

dc.source: Relay type 1 supply: DC variation 80...120 % of Un (ABB REF615 Product Guide 1MRS756379 U (5.0 FP1)). Trip coil: IEC 62271-1 shunt opening release 70...110 % of rated supply voltage (d.c.). Float voltage 121 V of a 110 V station battery: assumption: typical value, replace with your protection settings sheet / breaker data sheet

demo.note: Demo only: a short circuit on the feeder every 45 s of real time, cleared by the relay and the breaker, so the fault record (current, operate time, breaker opening time) updates often. A real feeder sees a few faults a year.

failure_modes.$comment: Each failure mode: what degrades, how it shows, the rules that see it.

settings_change.name: Unauthorised or unrecorded settings change
settings_change.symptoms: settings checksum no longer matches the Maximo record; the next fault trips on a different curve

trip_circuit_open.name: Trip circuit open (coil, wiring or auxiliary contact)
trip_circuit_open.symptoms: trip circuit supervision current lost: the relay can no longer trip the breaker

breaker_slow.name: Breaker mechanism slow (lubrication, latch, spring)
breaker_slow.symptoms: opening time after each trip grows; margin to the breaker failure timer shrinks

contact_wear.name: Interrupter contact wear
contact_wear.symptoms: accumulated I²t climbs towards the interrupter allowance

time_sync_loss.name: Loss of time synchronisation (PTP grandmaster or network)
time_sync_loss.symptoms: relay no longer locked; clock offset drifts; event and fault records lose their common time

dc_supply_low.name: Station DC supply low (charger or battery)
dc_supply_low.symptoms: auxiliary DC falls below the relay's supply range, then below the trip coil's minimum

goose_degraded.name: GOOSE messages lost or late (station bus)
goose_degraded.symptoms: missed and late GOOSE messages: blocking and breaker failure signals may not arrive in time

ct_circuit_fault.name: CT secondary circuit open or shorted
ct_circuit_fault.symptoms: residual current from the phases disagrees with the core-balance CT
